author: British Museum
title: British Museum catalogue record for drawing 2017,2018.2

notes.text: Modern catalogue entry for drawing 2017,2018.2. The catalogue attributes the drawing to Mathew James Harrison, Lieutenant, and dates the drawing to 1868. The curator's comment quotes Van Tilburg (2006:30) describing a red-scoria pukao at Puna Pau with canoe petroglyphs. Van Tilburg's Image 44 identifies the depicted object as Easter Island Statue Project 4-137-001, supporting this source's link to that object. The page's generic comment that a statue is in the British Museum does not identify the pukao as Hoa Hakananai'a. Image 1613289336 was downloaded from the museum's image page after that page identified this drawing and stated image-specific CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 terms. The former claim about the in-situ pukao is retained here after correcting the collection boundary: “Red scoria pukao, Puna Pau. Note petroglyphs of canoes (vaka), one with outrigger.” (Curator's comments, quoting Van Tilburg (2006:30)) The pukao is not a collection object because its displacement is not under investigation.
